items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including rank zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let α,β≥0 satisfy 0<α≤β and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for all x,v, and let η>0 with βη≤1. For arbitrary y,xRef and z=(x,p), define c=y−η∇V(xRef), Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), λ(xRef,(u,q))=√η max(0,⟨q,∇V(u)−∇V(xRef)⟩), H(z)=(η⁻¹‖x−c‖²+‖p‖²)/2, and C(z)=√η β√(2H(z))(√(2ηH(z))+‖c−xRef‖). For t≥0 put Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ(xRef,Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}, returning ∞ when this set is empty. Let W_z be the pushforward of Exp(1) on ℝ by e↦τ_z(max(e,0)). Then: (1) Λ is jointly continuous in y,xRef,z,t; (2) Λ is jointly Borel; (3) the actual orbit rate is integrable on every finite [0,t]; (4) Λ_z(0)=0, Λ_z(t)≥0 and Λ_z is nondecreasing; (5) for every e,t≥0, τ_z(e)≤t iff e≤Λ_z(t); (6) τ_z(e)=∞ iff Λ_z(t)<e for every finite t, finite τ_z(e) satisfies Λ_z(τ_z(e))=e, e>0 implies τ_z(e)>0, and τ_z(0)=0; (7) τ is jointly Borel in y,xRef,z,e; (8) W_z is a probability measure on [0,∞] and W_z((t,∞])=exp(−Λ_z(t)) for every finite t; (9) C(z)≥0 and Λ_z(t)≤C(z)t; (10) C(z)>0 implies max(e/C(z),0)≤τ_z(e), while C(z)=0 and e>0 imply τ_z(e)=∞. Every conclusion is derived for the actual flow and rate using their compiled laws. No unbounded-hazard or almost-sure finite-wait assumption is made. This is one flow-segment clock law used by AppendixA.1(A.1) and the future recursion(A.2). Recursive paths, nonexplosion, Markov memorylessness, invariance, terminal sampling kernels, main bounds and query costs remain open.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its compatible norm and Borel measurable structure; product spaces use product structures. Rank zero is allowed.
V:E→ℝ is C² on all E. The nonnegative α,β satisfy 0<α and α≤β, and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E.

η is real, η>0 and βη≤1. These are exactly the six original analytic callers. Flow/rate continuity, integrability, hazard monotonicity, an arbitrary cap, positivity of energy and finiteness of a random wait are never supplied as callers.
All y,xRef∈E, initial phase z=(x,p)∈E×E, continuous nonnegative times t and thresholds e≥0 are arbitrary. The eight c,Φ,λ,H,C,Λ,τ,W definitions below are the literal definitions.
τ takes values in [0,∞], with τ=∞ when no finite cumulative-hazard crossing exists. e=0 is included and gives τ=0. The finite-hitting identity has an explicit τ≠∞ guard.

W is the actual pushforward of the unit-rate real exponential measure under e↦τ(toNNReal e); its measurability and probability normalization are conclusions. The waiting lower bound assumes C>0 only in its own implication; the C=0,e>0 branch gives τ=∞.

formulae.label: Actual harmonic orbit
formulae.tex: c=y-\eta\nabla V(x_{\rm ref}),\quad\Phi_t(x,p)=\bigl(c+\cos t(x-c)+\sqrt\eta\sin t\,p,-\tfrac{\sin t}{\sqrt\eta}(x-c)+\cos t\,p\bigr).

formulae.label: Actual rate, energy and majorant
formulae.tex: \lambda(x_{\rm ref},(x,p))=\sqrt\eta\max\{0,\langle p,\nabla V(x)-\nabla V(x_{\rm ref})\rangle\},\quad H(z)=\tfrac12(\eta^{-1}\|x-c\|^2+\|p\|^2),\quad C(z)=\sqrt\eta\,\beta\sqrt{2H(z)}\bigl(\sqrt{2\eta H(z)}+\|c-x_{\rm ref}\|\bigr).
